5711.title: [skia-sync] Merge upstream chrome/m156 bug fixes
5711.body:
[Skia] Sync m156 Vulkan wait and displacement fixes (#5711)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/450
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5716
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/cb6f6ce6bf3aa7102bbffa49e4b760d948d68918...712ea097151d4951652dee046a8944376fd8df1b

Advance externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to native
merge 712ea097151d4951652dee046a8944376fd8df1b, incorporating chrome/m156 at
8e7863a6ff2ee1dbc6ec0631b61f3631852c8878. Keep this a servicing sync for
release/4.156.x: package versions, C API signatures, managed APIs and
dependency pins remain unchanged.

~~ Propagate failed Vulkan synchronous waits internally ~~

A successful queue submission could be reported as successful synchronous
submission even when the subsequent fence wait failed. Make
GrVkPrimaryCommandBuffer::forceSync return whether vkWaitForFences succeeded,
and require both queue submission and synchronization to succeed in
GrVkGpu::submitCommandBuffer.

Retain the VK_TIMEOUT retry, diagnostics and existing cleanup path.
Asynchronous submission behavior is unchanged. The C API already returns a
boolean, but GRContext.Submit remains void and discards that result; this
update does not introduce a managed failure return or exception.

~~ Keep displacement offsets consistent with filter bounds ~~

Half-precision displacement arithmetic could round differently from the
float-precision bounds calculations, making sampling disagree with the
computed filter bounds.

Use float2 for the scale uniform and displacement offset arithmetic in the
runtime effect and SkSL helper. Carry the corresponding generated shader
representations together; color-channel selection remains half precision
and the existing SkV2 uniform assignment remains compatible.

~~ Record the completed native merge without changing reviewed sources ~~

Repin both the gitlink and mono/skia manifest hash to the completed native
merge rather than the temporary reviewed head. The merge has two parents,
directly includes reviewed commit
796c0cc256ba1252fd0e755f5d8ec9f2dff9b608, and has the identical tree
3b4bc4c2a8d1fb836d51e84b827f172f58498c31.

Keep upstream_merge_commit at the incorporated upstream commit rather than
the fork merge SHA. The repin changes ancestry and commit identity, not
native source contents; independently regenerated binding trees matched
the reviewed source, and the repin does not require different declarations.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5687.title: [M156] Integrate Ganesh rendering and Graphite clip fixes
5687.body:
[M156] Integrate Ganesh rendering and Graphite clip fixes (#5687)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/444
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5698
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/d1717dc22ef2203b7fc9bf0e01078b37b1a4af6b...cb6f6ce6bf3aa7102bbffa49e4b760d948d68918

Advance externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to the
actual mono/skia merge cb6f6ce6bf3aa7102bbffa49e4b760d948d68918. Record
upstream 24e65cdd9b6421351dde22acd81dc604bd8073b8 on chrome/m156 while
retaining milestone 156 and the servicing line's version identities.

The merged native tree equals reviewed head
8c8de9aa05950b0b251924873c361a5441997b54. The dependent repin changes
commit identity and provenance, not the native source that was reviewed.
C API declarations and DEPS are unchanged; independent regeneration
found no binding differences. No managed API or release version changes.

~~ Avoid stale atlas work after empty Ganesh flushes ~~

Empty flushes could leave per-flush token comparisons stale. Advance
the draw token when GrOpFlushState resets and catch the flush token up,
so work scheduled during one flush is not treated as pending later.

~~ Correct transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry ~~

Fix the matrix-axis mapping of rrect radii and ellipse/rrect stroke
widths, and remove the redundant quarter-turn swap. Clamp transformed
corner radii to half the device-space bounds to prevent corner overlap.

~~ Keep Graphite clip draws within pass capacity ~~

Account for clip elements that still need recording without counting
already-recorded DrawListLayer clips twice. A fresh pass must fit the
draw and its full effective clip stack; warn and skip a draw that cannot
fit rather than exceeding render-step capacity.

The upstream DeviceTestClipRenderStepLimits regression exercises
accumulating and reused clip stacks, an oversized stack, and a normal
draw after restoring it, asserting that a recording can still be made.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
